data.description: Source series. For time-series methods a 'timestamp_column' is required.

timestamp_column.description: Required when method is time-series aware (stl, prophet-residual).

group_by.description: Optional grouping columns. Detection runs per group; results carry the group key.

method.description: Detection algorithm. 'z-score' and 'iqr' are stateless; 'rolling-z' uses a moving window; 'stl' decomposes seasonality+trend then scores residuals; 'isolation-forest' is multivariate when 'extra_features' is set.

threshold.description: Z/score threshold above which a point is flagged. Interpretation depends on method; runner clamps to a sane range.

window.description: Rolling window length for rolling-z / stl seasonal hint. Ignored by stateless methods.

extra_features.description: Additional columns for multivariate methods. Ignored by univariate methods.

anomalies.description: One entry per flagged point. Score interpretation depends on method (z, IQR-distance, residual-z, isolation score).

index.description: Row index in the source frame.

summary: Score a numeric series (or grouped panel) for anomalies using a vetted detector. Stateless methods plus seasonality-aware STL and multivariate isolation-forest.
notes: All methods are reviewable and reproducible — no opaque model artifact persists between calls. For monitored production series, drive this card from a scheduled-task and forward findings to a notification capability.
